items.source:
General exception to be thrown on scheduling failures,
such as the scheduler already having shut down.
Unchecked since scheduling failures are usually fatal.
items.translation: 调度失败时抛出的通用异常，例如调度器已经关闭。由于调度失败通常是致命的，因此该异常为 unchecked 类型。

items.source: cause - the root cause (usually from using an underlying scheduling API such as Quartz)
items.translation: cause - 根本原因（通常来自使用底层调度 API，如 Quartz）
